name: Reduced Terminal Obstructions with Exponential Protected Depth
definition: In one fixed $289$-concept rooted factor, replace active root direction $8$ by a block $E$ of size $m$, glue the resulting rooted factor to the second fixed factor, fill their mixed root cube, and add the punctured tip fibre $T_m=\{(32,t):t\in Q_E\setminus\{1_E\}\}$.
properties: Every $L_m$ is an ample pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness with empty protected core and $d_{\mathrm{prot}}(L_m)\ge2^m$. Every one-coordinate reduction peels. The minimum graph degree is at least three, and no two signed minimal-nonface columns agree up to sign, so both canonical graph-core and column-compression reductions fix the family.
